description: This file implements an in-memory session management service for handling user sessions and authentication state, including creation, retrieval, extension, invalidation, and cleanup of sessions.

classes.name: SessionService
classes.description: A class providing thread-safe in-memory management of user sessions, with methods to create, retrieve, extend, invalidate, and cleanup sessions.

methods.name: str create_session(self, service_type: ServiceType, user_info: Dict[str, Any], duration: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new user session with a specified service type, user info, and optional duration; returns the generated session ID.

methods.name: Optional[SessionInfo] get_session(self, session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves session information by session ID; returns None if not found or expired.

methods.name: bool extend_session(self, session_id: str, duration: Optional[timedelta] = None)
methods.description: Extends the expiration time of an existing session; returns True if successful.

methods.name: bool invalidate_session(self, session_id: str)
methods.description: Invalidates and removes a session by session ID; returns True if the session was successfully invalidated.

methods.name: cleanup_expired_sessions(self)
methods.description: Removes all expired sessions from the in-memory store.

methods.name: Dict[str,SessionInfo] get_active_sessions(self)
methods.description: Returns a copy of all currently active sessions, after cleaning up expired ones.

methods.name: Dict[str,SessionInfo] get_sessions_by_service(self, service_type: ServiceType)
methods.description: Returns all active sessions that match a specific service type.

ctags.name: create_session
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_session(self, service_type: ServiceType, user_info: Dict[str, Any], $/
ctags.signature: (self, service_type: ServiceType, user_info: Dict[str, Any], duration: Optional[timedelta] = None)

ctags.name: extend_session
ctags.pattern: /^    def extend_session(self, session_id: str, duration: Optional[timedelta] = None) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: get_sessions_by_service
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_sessions_by_service(self, service_type: ServiceType) -> Dict[str, SessionInfo]:$/
